court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Deputy Superintendent of Police, Office of Deputy Superintendent of Police and Others … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondent(s) : Mr. A. Damodaran Additional Public Prosecutor For R 1, R 2
judgment_text:
Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 BNSS to direct the principal Sessions Court, Special Court for SC/ST Act, Tirupathur to consider the surrender of the Petitioners and to accept the Bail Petition on the very same day in Cr. No. 134/2026 on the file of the Respondent Police.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

L. Victoria Gowri, J.:— This Criminal Original Petition has been filed seeking a direction to the learned principal Sessions Court, Special Court for SC/ST Act, Tirupathur to consider the surrender of the petitioners and to accept the bail petition on the same day in Crime No. 134 of 2026 on the file of the respondent police.

2. Considering the nature of the relief sought for, notice to the 3rd respondent is dispensed with.

3. The case of the prosecution is that the petitioners abused the defacto complainant by making caste-related remarks. Based on these allegations, an FIR has been registered against the petitioners.

4. Heard the learned counsel on either side and carefully perused the materials available on record.

5. Considering the limited scope of the relief sought for, this Court hereby direct the learned principal Sessions Court, Special Court for SC/ST Act, Tirupathur, to issue prior notice to the de facto complainant and thereafter, to consider the bail application of the petitioners on the same day of their surrender before that Court in connection with Crime No. 134 of 2026 on the file of the 2 respondent police. The petitioners shall surrender before the learned trial court within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

6. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
